reason: It looks lovely, but I have never managed to leave my phone in another room, and my phone alarm already works and costs nothing. I would be paying 120 euros for a habit change I have not made yet.
objection: How accurate can a sleep and snoring estimate from a microphone be? And I would still want my phone next to me, so this becomes one more object on the bedside table.
would_change_my_mind: A reviewer or friend I trust showing it really got them to leave their phone outside the bedroom, or a lower price with a real return window.
